US law firm investigates HDFC Bank over disclosures

US law firm Glancy Prongay & Rotter has initiated a securities law investigation into HDFC Bank. The probe follows reports of alleged payment irregularities and months of governance scrutiny. The investigation focuses on the bank's disclosures in the US. HDFC Bank shares fell 3% in May following earlier reports.
